title: asplenium fontanum
intro: Asplenium fontanum, commonly known as the maiden's hair fern, is a type of vascular plant and a member of the Aspleniaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Asplenium fontanum include being an antiseptic, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which contribute to its ability to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
